name: skillsmith
description: Self-maintaining knowledge for opencode: skills (skillsmith), knowledge base + glossary (docsmith), errors with fixes (errorsmith), tested Python scripts (toolsmith), project memories (memorysmith), relations and conflicts (doctor); a local web workplace (knowledge base with editor and [[links]], tasks and kanban board, projects with pipeline, agent tasks with proposal/approval in git worktrees, audit log, metrics and statistics) – background reviewers, curator, hybrid search, git-tracked changes.
